articles.title_en: Russian propagandist’s interview sparks debate over whether he deserves sympathy
articles.lead_en: On April 13, Ksenia Sobchak released an interview with TV host Anton Krasovsky, a figure known for moving from liberal circles into Russia’s conservative camp. Once a recognizable journalist at glossy magazines, he became an aggressive war propagandist and was fired from the Russian state propaganda outlet RT for calling for Ukrainian children to be “drowned” and “burned.” Krasovsky is openly gay and founded a foundation to help people living with HIV.

articles.title_en: Volunteers in Russia rescue oil-soaked birds as new petroleum slick hits Black Sea coast
articles.lead_en: Volunteers in Anapa are again rescuing birds contaminated by petroleum products, and the worker leading the effort says the pollution comes from a new spill.
